follow_up.reference: Its sum is zero and the limit is nonnegative. It is one selection, regardless of the number of possible starting positions.

instances.text: A sample tray has values 0, 10, 2, 5, 2, 0. Count subsets of positions whose total is at most 0, including the empty subset. Equal values at different positions remain separate choices. What is the count, as a whole number?

instances.spoken_text: A sample tray has values zero, ten, two, five, two, zero. Count subsets of positions whose total is at most zero, including the empty subset. Equal values at different positions remain separate choices. What is the count, as a whole number?

follow_up.question: Why keep equal-valued items separate?
follow_up.reference: Selections are defined by positions. Choosing the first copy differs from choosing the second copy.
